root_cause.mechanism: The producer of run 39422328377 committed its entire delta itself as commit 44d4904 ('Frontier frontier-counter-label-emission v1 run 39422328377: promote A_EMISSION_RECOVERED ...', 2026-10-20T12:56:11Z) and left a clean working tree. The frontier-team.yml post-execution gate requires an UNCOMMITTED durable delta (it fails with exit 67 when 'git diff --quiet && git diff --cached --quiet && git status --porcelain -uall is empty'), because the workflow's own 'Persist team snapshot' step is the component that is supposed to create the snapshot commit. Because the tree was clean, the gate could not see the work, failed the team job, and the audit job (needs.team.result == 'success') was skipped.
